main_text.head: III. ALEXANDER tertius.
main_text.p: ALexander tertius, natione Hetruscus, patria Senensis, Rolandus cancellarius antea vocatus, Hadriano Anglo musca deglutita, ut dictum est, suffocato, immanior adhuc bestia successit. Sed quia in eius electionem non omnes concordare poterant, nouem Cardinales, qui ab Imperatoris parte steterant, alium constituerunt Pontificem: nempe Octauianum Romanum ciuem, presbyterum Cardinalem titulo S. Clementis, quem Victorem quartum appellabant. Continuato quoq; post hu-ius Victoris mortem schismate, ordine successe-runt, Paschalis, Calixtus & Innocentius, Alexan-dro opponentes, & magnos tumultus in Eccle-sia Romana dederunt: omnesq; perierunt, eo adhuc superstite. Cum autem Imperator Fridericus, ut lites dirimeret, Papiae conuentum indixisset, & utrunq; Pontificem illuc uocasset, ut causa discuteretur, is qui iure diceretur Pontifex, in officio confirmaretur: Alexander, spretis eius nuncijs, superbissime respondebat, Pontificem Romanum a nemine debere iudicari: legatosq; a se contemptos repulit: ac missis per totam Christianitatem literis, Imperatorem ipsum cum Victore pontifice excommunicationis flagello feriebat. Et ut Romanam urbem in fide retineret, literas ad Ioannem

page.notes: Printed text is set in a large decorative initial "A" followed by small capitals "LEXANDER" in the heading and opening line; transcribed as printed. The catchword at the lower right is partly cut off and reads as "ecclesia" with a dash, rendered as "eccle[?]". Spellings are kept as printed (q;, &, quoq;, utrunq;, uocasset, conuentum, nouem, Octauianum). Verb "superbissime" and "successe-runt" are printed with line-end hyphens. Scan is slightly blurred on the left edge, so some letters in "Hetruscus" and "Clementis" are uncertain.
